title: SSRF dedicated runner: server-side request forgery detection via OOB callbacks and internal service probing
goal: WebGoat has a dedicated SSRF module. ZAP has basic SSRF checks (scanner 40022) but misses many variants. Implement a dedicated ssrf-probe runner: (1) Parameter-based SSRF: inject OOB callback URLs into all URL-consuming parameters (url=, redirect=, callback=, webhook=, proxy=, fetch=, load=, src=, href=, target=, domain=, host=, endpoint=). Use Interactsh or a self-hosted callback server to detect blind SSRF. (2) Header-based SSRF: inject callback URLs into Host, X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-For, Referer headers. (3) File/path SSRF: inject file:// and dict:// protocols alongside http://. (4) Internal service detection: attempt requests to http://169.254.169.254 (AWS metadata), http://metadata.google.internal (GCP), http://localhost:80/admin, common internal IPs. Record any 200 responses with internal content. (5) PDF/image conversion SSRF: if PDF/image generation endpoints found (common in modern apps), inject SSRF payload in document URL. All SSRF tests require active tier approval. Findings: 'SSRF - Blind (OOB Confirmed)', 'SSRF - Internal Service Accessible', 'SSRF - Cloud Metadata Exposed'.
scope: WebGoat ssrf module + gap analysis: ZAP scanner 40022 covers basic SSRF but misses blind OOB SSRF, header injection SSRF, and cloud metadata endpoints. SSRF is OWASP A10:2021. Current coverage ⚠️ (partial).
generation_reason: SSRF partial coverage — ZAP misses blind OOB, header SSRF, and cloud metadata variants. WebGoat SSRF module confirms the gap.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: SSRF detection only — do not follow SSRF chains to internal services beyond basic response fingerprinting.
constraints.safety: Never use real internal IPs outside the engagement's approved CIDR. Cloud metadata probes only when target is confirmed cloud-hosted.

success_criteria: ssrf-probe detects blind SSRF via OOB callback on WebGoat.
Detects parameter-based SSRF in common URL params.
Cloud metadata SSRF produces Critical finding.
